description: Consumer record of one decision per rule of an UnverifiedObligationsManifest, each with a human judgement. Shape only: the library does not grade judgements or decide authority (ADR-010). See SDD §3 and MC-1.

schema_id.description: schema_id of the manifest this receipt answers.

contract_version.description: contract_version of the manifest this receipt answers.

manifest_emitted_at.description: manifest_emitted_at of the manifest this receipt answers; together with schema_id it identifies the manifest.

consumer_id.description: Opaque identifier of the consuming system (MCR-N3).

rule_id.description: rule_id of the manifest entry (or entries) this decision covers.

reason.description: The manifest entry reason this decision answers. Not checked against the reason union (MCR-N2).

decision.description: Consumer decision for one manifest rule (SDD §3).

judgement.description: The approver's answer to the contract row's judgement_requested question, with any rationale. Never graded by the library (MCR-N1).

evidence_ref.description: Opaque pointer to evidence supporting the decision (URI, hash, ticket id).

decided_at.description: When the receipt as a whole was finalized.
